bullets: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1: recover orphaned code-behind XAML (a *.xaml.cs copied without its sibling *.xaml) from the source build output (obj/bin), track it in the mapping, and flag any unrecoverable orphan — prevents the WMC0909/InitializeComponent build cascade that scored this migration 0/11.

MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md + SKILL.md: document the 'missing/orphaned source XAML' pattern (auto-recovery + author-it fallback preserving x:Class/x:Name/handlers) so the agent handles absent markup deterministically instead of stalling.
deferred_to_human: Optional Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 backstop check that every page *.xaml.cs has a sibling *.xaml.
